name: Sármán Rozál — additional daughter Viktoria (b. abt. 1892)
researcher_question: Did Rozál Sármán and her husband István Juhász of Torontál, Hungary have a daughter named Viktoria, baptized about 1892, in addition to their known daughter Ágnes (b. 1894)?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 28, flag adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved: FALSE MATCH — the hinted baptismal record (ark:/61903/1:1:XZ6D-FZY; manuscript image ark:/61903/3:1:9Q97-YS8R-ZWF, entry 48) names the mother as Rozál Száz, not Rozál Sármán; the two surnames admit no transcription path, so the record belongs to a different couple (Kiszombor house 269).
